description.zh: 账期YYYY－MM。仅支持最近18个月账期。
description.en: The billing cycle in YYYY-MM format. Only billing cycles in the last 18 months are supported.

description.zh: 账单日期，仅当**Granularity**为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD。
description.en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when **Granularity** is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

description.zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值：
- MONTHLY：月。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期”账单一致。
- DAILY：日。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天”账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定**BillingDate**。
description.en:
The granularity of the bills to query. Valid values:

- MONTHLY: monthly. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by billing cycle in the User Center.

- DAILY: daily. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by day in the User Center.

If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must also specify **BillingDate**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.
The ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-bill --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAVz7BQqj2xtiNSC3d3RAD38= --service-instance-id si-49793f3bfa034ec6a990 --billing-cycle 2024-05 --granularity DAILY --billing-date 2025-04-01 --region cn-hangzhou
